thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO breaches detected for shared-gpu-pool-3 - p95 latency 1.9s (SLO 800ms), p99 3.6s. Streaming stalls observed for 10% of requests. Auto-escalation triggered.

alex_oncall: Acked. I'm grabbing the first pass. Paging SREs, posting current cluster metrics.

priya_sre: On it. Is this region-specific? Seeing spikes in eu-west-1 dashboards.

mateo_infra: Confirmed. Block device write latency on host gpu-node-17 is high. nvme0n1 avg_write_ms spiking. Likely IO backpressure. Suspect noisy tenant.

jin_runtime: Correlating with streaming logs — requests with long generation lengths show repeated flushes. Could be cgroup writeback + pagecache pressure.

alex_oncall: Running quick checks:
```
ssh gpu-node-17 'iostat -x 1 3 | grep nvme0n1 -A1'
# dev   r/s  w/s  rkB/s  wkB/s  await  svctm  %util
# nvme0n1 10 240  1280 25600  25.3  1.2   98.6
```
Also:
```
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/unified/.../io.stat
8:0 rbytes=12345678 wbytes=987654321 rios=120 wios=450
```

priya_sre: Grabbed top process in the cgroup for tenant_42:
```
ps -eo pid,cmd --sort=-%mem | grep tenant_42
# 45123  /opt/redwood/serve --tenant tenant_42 --model redwood-v2
```

mateo_infra: tenant_42 writes look insane — checkpointing + logging to local disk. Their process doing frequent fsyncs. Looks like cgroup IO limits not applied (we rolled a config last week).

jin_runtime: If cgroup limits dropped, noisy neighbor makes sense. We should throttle tenant_42 IO and move them to dedicated pool. Quick mitigation: set io.max for their cgroup to cap write throughput.

alex_oncall: Proposed mitigations:
1) apply temporary io cap to tenant_42 cgroup
2) reduce their batch size / concurrent streams (runtime flag)
3) migrate active connections to warm spillover pool if cap not enough
4) if impact persists, evict heavy jobs and create dedicated node

priya_sre: Doing step 1 now:
```
echo '8:0 rbps=0 wbps=150M' > /sys/fs/cgroup/.../tenant_42/io.max
```
Status: write I/O dropped ~70% within 30s. p95 improved to 920ms.

sam_cs: Heads up — Customer Success, flagging tenant_42 (acme-inc) as possibly impacted. Preparing outreach if we need to evict or restart.

mateo_infra: Also patching our cgroup config generator — it looks like a regression in change 4e9b. Rolling a fix to infra-config-prod.

ops-bot: Deploy started for infra-config-prod -> infra-config-prod/2026-03-15T09:40Z

jin_runtime: Applying runtime throttle for tenant_42 to lower concurrency:
```
redwoodctl tenants update tenant_42 --max-concurrency 4 --streaming-batch 8
```

alex_oncall: After throttles and io cap, p99 down to 1.8s, streaming stall rate 2%. Still above SLO but much improved. Next: migrate long-running jobs off gpu-node-17.

priya_sre: Initiating migration (live-migrate) for two largest pods:
```
redwoodctl migrate --pod pod-45123 --to-pool dedicated-gpu-12 --force
```

mateo_infra: Migration in progress, pod-45123 live-migrated successfully. Node healthy metrics returning to baseline.

sam_cs: I've flagged impacted customers and drafted a short message: "We're investigating elevated latencies on shared GPU pool and are actively throttling noisy workloads. No data loss. More info to follow." Want approval to send.

alex_oncall: Approved.

priya_sre: ops-bot reports infra-config-prod deploy succeeded. Closing immediate remediation loop. Monitoring for 30m.

ops-bot: ALERT: deploy infra-config-prod succeeded - 7/7 hosts updated

jin_runtime: Post-mitigation metrics: p95 410ms, p99 780ms, streaming stall 0.6% - under SLO. Confirming tail latency histogram looks clean.

alex_oncall: Handoff to Priya for postmortem and follow-ups (I'm OOO in 25m). Priya, please include root cause, timeline, and customer impact. Assign to Mateo for infra fix and to Jin for runtime safeguards.

priya_sre: Ack. I'll open incident ticket and include timeline + suggested action items: fix cgroup config regression, add automated detection for rising write backpressure, auto-cap noisy tenants, and run canary for infra-config changes.

sam_cs: Adding CS followup: reach out to ACME support with details and offer a 10% credit for the affected window.

priya_sre: Last check-in: monitoring stable for 20m. Marking incident as mitigated but not resolved until postmortem complete.

alex_oncall: Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED (not resolved) - followup task created: INC-2026-0843
